comment: The terminology side lists FHIR terminology resources and major code systems but omits unit standards such as UCUM and may underrepresent local or national code systems.

citation.caption: Table 3.5
citation.raw: §3.5.3.1 p.70 l.Table 3.5, “Standards it uses or produces”

public.text: The terminology side lists FHIR terminology resources and major code systems but omits unit standards such as UCUM and may underrepresent local or national code systems.
public.suggestedRevision: Add UCUM and explicitly include nationally governed and local code systems, naming systems, identifier systems, and mapping artefacts where no appropriate international terminology exists.
